title: Pullback transports degree-zero boundary subgroups
statement: Let k ⊆ k' be algebraically closed fields [def-sc-field-extension], f:C→Spec k a smooth affine connected curve [def-sc-curves], and c a smooth proper connected compactification [lem-sc-compactification], with relative dimension one before and after base change. Let P₀ be a closed boundary point. Write c' for the base-changed compactification [lemma-nagata-compactification-base-change] and j:Pic(c.Z)→Pic(c'.Z) for pullback [def-sc-picard-group]. Then there exists a boundary closed point Q₀ of c'.Z such that the following holds. For any subgroups G and G' whose underlying sets equal Pic⁰(c.Z) and Pic⁰(c'.Z) [def-sc-pic0], and subgroups Λ≤G, Λ'≤G' whose images in the ambient Picard groups are respectively generated by [P]/[P₀] and [Q]/[Q₀] for boundary closed points P and Q, pullback j carries G into G' and induces an isomorphism Λ≃Λ' whose underlying ambient Picard class at every L∈Λ is j(L). Here [P] is the class of O(P) [def-pc-divisor-line-bundle].

source.place: Affine case, compactification/boundary and final compatibility paragraphs; expanded from the proof recorded in lem-sc-pic-affine-base-change-compatibility

proof.text: Apply boundary_point_class_base_change to obtain a boundary bijection and pullback equality for point classes. Choose Q0 as the image of P0. Pullback preserves division, and surjectivity of the boundary bijection identifies the images of the two generator sets.

Represent each Picard class by its skeleton module. degree_pullback_of_isPullback and degree_congr prove equality of degrees. Thus pullback restricts to the given degree-zero subgroup models G and G prime. picZero_torsion_base_change with n=1 proves injectivity of this restricted homomorphism.

MonoidHom.map_closure identifies the mapped ambient boundary subgroup with the new one. The subtype homomorphism is injective, so equality of its mapped subgroups proves map t Lambda = Lambda prime. Compose Subgroup.equivMapOfInjective with MulEquiv.subgroupCongr; the ambient pointwise formula is definitional.

proof_origin.place: Boundary point comparison followed by degree invariance, existing Picard-zero injectivity, and explicit subgroup closure algebra

lean.statement:
theorem pic_boundary_base_change_transport
    {k k' : Type u} [Field k] [Field k'] [Algebra k k'] [IsAlgClosed k] [IsAlgClosed k']
    {C : Scheme.{u}} (f : C ⟶ Spec (.of k)) [IsConnectedCurve f] [Smooth f] [IsAffine C]
    (c : Compactification f) [IsConnectedCurve c.g] [Smooth c.g]
    [hsm : SmoothOfRelativeDimension 1 c.g]
    [hsm' : SmoothOfRelativeDimension 1
      (c.baseChange (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap k k')))).g]
    (P₀ : closedPoints c.Z) (hP₀ : P₀.val ∉ Set.range c.i.base) :
    let b := Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap k k'))
    let c' := c.baseChange b
    let j := Scheme.Pic.mapHom (pullback.fst c.g b)
    ∃ Q₀ : closedPoints c'.Z, Q₀.val ∉ Set.range c'.i.base ∧
      ∀ (G : Subgroup c.Z.Pic) (_ : (G : Set c.Z.Pic) = c.g.picZero)
        (Λ : Subgroup G),
        Subgroup.map G.subtype Λ = Subgroup.closure
          {L | ∃ P : closedPoints c.Z, P.val ∉ Set.range c.i.base ∧
            L = @Scheme.Pic.ofClosedPoint k _ c.Z ⟨c.g⟩ hsm P /
              @Scheme.Pic.ofClosedPoint k _ c.Z ⟨c.g⟩ hsm P₀} →
      ∀ (G' : Subgroup c'.Z.Pic) (_ : (G' : Set c'.Z.Pic) = c'.g.picZero)
        (Λ' : Subgroup G'),
        Subgroup.map G'.subtype Λ' = Subgroup.closure
          {L | ∃ P : closedPoints c'.Z, P.val ∉ Set.range c'.i.base ∧
            L = @Scheme.Pic.ofClosedPoint k' _ c'.Z ⟨c'.g⟩ hsm' P /
              @Scheme.Pic.ofClosedPoint k' _ c'.Z ⟨c'.g⟩ hsm' Q₀} →
        (∀ L : G, j L.val ∈ G') ∧
        ∃ ej : Λ ≃* Λ', ∀ L : Λ, (ej L : c'.Z.Pic) = j L.val
